title: Deadline: Jane Campion & Matt Dougherty on their Telluride doc 'The Natural State'
description: Deadline interview ahead of the world premiere of the UG documentary The Natural State at Telluride 2026; Campion executive produced.

title: Variety India: Mahesh Bhatt on Matthew Dougherty's 'The Natural State'
description: Mahesh Bhatt (co-executive producer) quoted: 'The film has been born, the director has been born, UG Krishnamurti has escaped'. Film described as nearly 17 years in the making.

title: The Film Stage: Woodstock Review - The Natural State Examines the Contradictory State of Non-Belief
description: Review from Woodstock Film Festival 2026; calls the film 'a challenging text, in no small part because U.G. himself is challenging'.

title: AWFJ: The Natural State (Telluride FF 2026) review by Diane Carson
description: Alliance of Women Film Journalists review; 'a decidedly unusual documentary'. Companion Telluride overview part two also mentions the film.

title: The Overlook News: A Film 18 Years in the Making Found Its Footing in a Hudson Valley WhatsApp Group
description: Local feature on the making of The Natural State (project began 2008 after Dougherty found Julie Thayer's 1989 footage online); Woodstock FF screening 17 Oct 2026, Orpheum Theatre, Saugerties.

title: Upstate Films: The Natural State (film page)
description: Listing gives runtime 99 min; co-executive produced by Jane Campion and Mahesh Bhatt. TV Guide lists 1h42.

title: cuke.com: Death of U.G. Krishnamurti (press compilation)
description: Compiles reports of UG's death on 22 March 2007 including a DNA (Daily News and Analysis) notice giving his age as 89; notes The Hindu reported the death on 25 March 2007.

title: What the Press and Others Say About U.G. (WELL, ntbook3.htm)
description: WELL page compiling press quotes about UG, including a 1987 City Magazine (Bombay) item; part of the WELL mirror of the Sowmya/Dinesh books.

title: ugkrishnamurti.in Resources & Archive: press clippings 1970-2000 (Deccan Herald 1981-1993 etc.)
description: Official site index of magazine and newspaper clippings 1970-2000 including Deccan Herald pieces 1981-1993 on his 'Natural State', his views on money, and being labelled a godman.

title: Narayana Moorty, 'Fragmentation, Meditation, and Transformation' (JICPR V.2, 1988)
description: Journal of Indian Council of Philosophical Research, Vol. V No. 2, Jan-Apr 1988; listed among Moorty's papers on his site; draws on UG.

title: Narayana Moorty, 'Thought, the Natural State and the Body: Deconstruction of Spirituality in U.G. Krishnamurti' (2007)
description: Paper presented 21 Sept 2007 at the International Congress of Vedanta.

title: Narayana Moorty, 'Science and Spirituality' (Krishnamurti Centennial Conference, Miami University, Oxford OH, 1995)
description: Presented May 18-21 1995; discusses UG alongside the conference theme; copy hosted on a UG blog.

title: T.R. Raghunath, 'The Unrational Philosophy of U.G. Krishnamurti' (chapter in No Way Out)
description: Essay by T.R. Raghunath (McMaster Dept. of Philosophy) printed in No Way Out (1991) alongside Moorty's introduction dated August 1991; full text on Wikisource and scribd.

title: Online Books Page: U. G. Krishnamurti (Uppaluri Gopala) author entry
description: UPenn Online Books Page author entry listing freely available UG texts.

title: La mente è un mito. Conversazioni sconcertanti con un uomo chiamato U.G. (Aequilibrium, trans. Giovanni Turchi)
description: Italian translation of Mind is a Myth; first Aequilibrium 1990, current edition ISBN 9788898365098, c.183 pp. A separate Italian rendering 'La mente come mito' trans. F. Pellegrini circulates online (meditare.net, gianfrancobertagni.it).

title: La mente es un mito: Inquietantes conversaciones con un hombre llamado U.G. (Editorial Sirio, trans. Ricardo de Frutos)
description: Spanish Mind is a Myth. Editions: Sirio 1st ed. Oct 2002 (ISBN 9788478084821, 272 pp.), 2013 (ISBN 9788478088959, 216 pp.), 2017 ebook (ISBN 9788478089246). Sirio described as pioneer publisher of UG in Spanish.

title: De moed om te zijn wie je bent (Samsara Uitgeverij, 2016)
description: Dutch Courage to Stand Alone, hardcover 150 pp., ISBN 9789491411366; ebook ISBN 9789491411380. Foreword Henk Schonewille, introduction Julie Thayer; based on 1982 Amsterdam conversations, revised and expanded.

title: Das Denken ist dein Feind (BoD, 2016, trans. Doris Baumgartner)
description: German Thought is Your Enemy; BoD Books on Demand 2016, ISBN 9783837094497 (ISBN-10 3837094499); original Sowmya 1991.

title: Der trügerische Schein der Erleuchtung: Die radikalen Ideen eines radikalen Menschen (Noumenon Verlag, 2011)
description: German Mystique of Enlightenment, Noumenon Verlag 2011, ISBN 9783941973077. Also 'Die Mystik der Erleuchtung' ebook (pocketbook.de) and 'Der Mut allein zu stehen: Ausgabe in neuer Übersetzung' (Neu übersetzt Verlag, Dec 2024) and 'Der natürliche Zustand' (2025). Earlier online German 'Das Ende der Sehnsucht' (2002) listed on ugkrishnamurti.in.

title: Ум — это миф. Беседы с У.Г. Кришнамурти (Ганга, 2011/2014/2017)
description: Russian Mind is a Myth, publisher Ganga, series 'Не2' (nonduality). Editions: 2011 ISBN 978-5-98882-118-2; 2014 ISBN 978-5-906154-74-3, 236 pp. (translators Remizova, Gorina); 2017 reprint. Earlier Ganga volume of Mystique translated as 'Ошибка просветления' / 'Загадка просветления'. Free fb2 copies circulate (coollib, royallib).

title: La Pensée est votre ennemie (Deux Océans, 1989, trans. Paule Salvan)
description: French Thought is Your Enemy (note: dated 1989, i.e. before the English Sowmya 1990/91 edition, per Fnac; verify). Deux Océans, broché.

title: Le mental est un mythe: entretiens déroutants avec U.G. Krishnamurti (Deux Océans, 2000)
description: French Mind is a Myth, Deux Océans, 176 pp., ISBN 9782866810238.

title: Le dos au mur ou le mythe de la perfection (Deux Océans, 2001)
description: French edition of No Way Out, Deux Océans paperback 2001.

title: Rencontres avec un éveillé contestataire (2000) and Coloquintessence - Instantané avec U.G.
description: French testimony about UG described as 'un témoignage subversif et exceptionnel' (2000); Babelio additionally lists 'Coloquintessence - Instantané avec U.G.' under UG's author page. Authors/publishers to confirm.

title: Umysł jest mitem. Niepokojące rozmowy z człowiekiem zwanym U.G. (Thesaurus Press, 1994)
description: Polish Mind is a Myth, Thesaurus Press 1994, ISBN 8385812024, 106/144 pp. Cezary Wójcik's online Polish translations of Mind Is a Myth, No Way Out, Courage to Stand Alone and Thought Is Your Enemy are hosted on ugkrishnamurti.in.

title: Illi Vadavilla - Iruvudella Veda (Kannada, B.A. Ranganath, 1978)
description: Per the WELL 'Books, Interviews, and References' list, the first publication on UG (1978) was a Kannada translation of his conversations by B.A. Ranganath, M.A., titled 'Illi Vadavilla - Iruvudella Veda'.

title: U.G. Krishnamurti - Oka Jeevita Katha (Telugu translation of Mahesh Bhatt's biography, K. Chandrasekhar, 1994)
description: Telugu rendering of 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life' by K. Chandrasekhar, published 1994 (WELL bibliography).

title: మనసొక మిథ్య (Manasoka Mithya) - Telugu Mind is a Myth (J.S. Subrahmanyam, 2022) and 'About U.G. Krishnamurti?' (Telugu, 2017)
description: 2022 Telugu edition of Mind Is a Myth; J.S. Subrahmanyam also self-published 'About U.G. Krishnamurti? (Telugu Edition)' ISBN 9781543160451 (CreateSpace, 2017).

title: WELL: Books, Interviews, and References (lists.html)
description: J.C. Thomas's bibliography of UG books, translations and interviews on the WELL, incl. Kannada 1978 title, Telugu 1994 biography, Stopped in Our Tracks (Smriti Books 2005) and second series.

title: WELL: No Way Out chapter files (nwo1.htm ...)
description: Confirmed filename nwo1.htm = 'No Way Out: Chapter 1'; sequence presumably nwo1..nwoN. Also confirmed: enemy0.htm (Thought is Your Enemy), cover.html (Mind is a Myth front), ThoughtG.html (German Thought), ugbio/ugbio4.htm (A Life ch.4 'Locking of Horns'), Final_Remembering.htm, ntbook3.htm.

title: remembering-ug.blogspot.com: 'The End of the Search' - Talks, Passages, Photos, E-Books and Videos
description: Blog with 'Book of Passages' (a collection from various books, Nov 2012), 'Passages from Thought is Your Enemy' (Nov 2012), passages from Courage to Stand Alone, and E-Books downloads.

title: The Book of Passages - U.G. Krishnamurti (Internet Archive)
description: Compilation of passages from UG books, marked public domain on Internet Archive.

title: o-meditation.com (Sat Sangha Salon): U.G. Krishnamurti Books and Audios
description: Index page of downloadable UG books and audios.

title: holybooks.com: The Natural State in the Words of U.G. Krishnamurti (ed. Peter Maverick) PDF
description: Free PDF of The Natural State compiled by Peter Maverick; Online Books Page lists the HTML at blogspot.

title: UG Krishnamurti: Collected Works (e-bookshelf preview PDF)
description: Reading sample of a 'Collected Works' e-book edition; publisher to identify.

title: This Dog Barking: The Strange Story of U.G. Krishnamurti (Nicolas C. Grey & James Farley, Harper Element/HarperCollins India, 2017)
description: ISBN 9789352643776 (ISBN-10 9352643771), 168 pp., Harper Element imprint of HarperCollins Publishers India; dates vary Jan-Mar 2017. Not Non-Duality Press. Stray ISBNs 9782654220102 / 9789352643783 appear in some listings.

title: Julie Thayer, Get Lost and Stay Lost: Travels with UG Krishnamurti (with 'UG Krishnamurti Cookbook')
description: Memoir covering 1989-2007; copies on archive.org, vdoc.pub (454 pp., '2006'), dokumen.pub (487 pp., '2023'). No publisher or ISBN found - apparently self-published/privately circulated PDF.

title: 14 Days in Palm Springs with UG Krishnamurti (PDF, dokumen.pub)
description: Circulating PDF transcript/memoir of two weeks with UG in Palm Springs; author/compiler and date to confirm.

title: Louis Brawley, Goner: The Final Travels of UG Krishnamurti (Non-Duality Press, 2011; rev. 2016)
description: ISBN 9780956643278; e-ISBN 9781626257382; now distributed by New Harbinger/Hachette UK. Revised edition 2016.

title: Louis Brawley, No More Questions: The Final Travels of U.G. Krishnamurti (Penguin India, Dec 2012)
description: Penguin Books India edition, ISBN 9780143417347 (also 9788184758795 for ebook); 2012 not 2011.

title: Mukunda Rao, The Other Side of Belief: Interpreting U.G. Krishnamurti (Penguin India, 2005)
description: Indexed on PhilPapers (RAOTOS); Penguin page describes it as a chronicle of UG's life and the evolution of his radical vision.

title: The Biology of Enlightenment: Unpublished Conversations of U.G. Krishnamurti after he came into the Natural State (1967-71), ed. Mukunda Rao (HarperCollins India, 2010)
description: Indexed on PhilPapers (KRITBO-2); HarperCollins 2010; 2015 reprint on AbeBooks.

title: T.R. Raghunath, 'The Unrational Philosophy of U.G. Krishnamurti' (PDF, stillnessspeaks.com)
description: Standalone PDF of the No Way Out chapter; reads UG as 'a naturalistic or physicalistic advaita in contrast to Shankara's metaphysical or transcendental Advaita'.

title: Stopped in Our Tracks (Series 1, Smriti Books 2005; Second Series, Firsthand Publications Bangalore; Third Series) - K. Chandrasekhar, trans. Narayana Moorty
description: Series 1 'Stories of U.G. in India' Smriti Books, New Delhi 2005; Second Series 'UG-Anecdotes, Comments and Reflections' (Firsthand Publications, Bangalore per sulochanosho blog); a Third Series is referenced. No ISBNs found for any volume.

title: Mahesh Bhatt, A Taste of Life: The Last Days of U.G. Krishnamurti (Penguin India, 2009)
description: ISBNs: 9780143067160 (Penguin Global pb 2010), 9780143430384 (PRH India pb), 9789351182474 (ebook, June 2009). Reviewed in Journal of Cancer Research and Therapeutics (2015).

title: Mahesh Bhatt, U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life (Viking 1992; Penguin rev. 2001 with 'A Taste of Death'; audiobook 2022)
description: Viking 1992 ISBN 9780140126204; Penguin 2001 revised ISBN 9780141008097 including 'A Taste of Death' (1995 Gstaad journal); PRH Audio 2022 ISBN 9789354928208.

title: Mark Whitwell, 'Understanding U.G. Krishnamurti' interview, Parts 1-2 (Medium, 2022)
description: Two-part interview with yoga teacher Mark Whitwell (knew UG 1973-2007); Part 2 on UG's 'wrathfulness' as compassion.

title: Mariana Caplan, 'U.G. Krishnamurti: The Divine Anarchist' (2002; repr. advaita.org.uk, Awakening Times)
description: Essay profiling UG ('no students, no organization... collects no money'); written 2002 and republished after his death.

title: WELL: ugbio/ugbio4.htm 'Locking of Horns' (A Life, ch. 4 - Theosophical Society years 1947-53)
description: Chapter of Bhatt's biography on the WELL covering UG's seven years lecturing for the Theosophical Society (1947-53) in India, Europe and America; the main online source on the TS-era lectures. No primary lecture texts located.

title: encyclopedia.com: 'Krishnamurti, U. G.' (Encyclopedia of World Biography entry)
description: Reference entry: 'Indian philosopher and writer Uppaluri Gopala (U.G.) Krishnamurti (1918-2007) has been described as the anti-guru'. Only encyclopaedia entry located; no Brill/Routledge/Oxford handbook chapter found.

title: Mukunda Rao obituary / 'About UG' on ugkrishnamurti.in
description: Obituary account by Mukunda Rao: fall seven weeks before death, refusal of medical intervention, cremation by Mahesh Bhatt next day 2.45 pm at Vallecrosia with no rites.

title: u-g-k.fr: UG biography PDF ('U.G. Krishnamurti Born 9 July 1918 Machilipatnam...')
description: Only u-g-k.fr file surfaced by search: a biographical PDF uploaded July 2025. The site's own French translation listings were not reachable via search.

title: Larry Morris, U.G. Krishnamurti: Dangerous Friend (2015)
description: ISBN 9781511460699 (CreateSpace), 208 pp. Morris travelled with UG on and off for c.21 years and wrote the introduction to Peter Maverick's The Natural State.

title: Larry Morris, The Natural Man: Poems on U.G. (also Living Treasure: Poems on U.G.; U.G. Krishnamurti: A Journey of Healing) - thenaturalman.blogspot.com
description: Poetry on UG by Larry Morris (not Peter Maverick), posted on blogspot 2005; blog quotes a 1995 Mountain Path review, implying a mid-1990s print edition. No ISBN found. Sample poem 'Nirvakalpa Heart'.

title: Thought is Your Enemy, ed. Antony Paul Frank Noronha & J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty (Sowmya 1990; Smriti ed. with Sunita Pant Bansal) - Internet Archive scan
description: Confirms Frank Noronha's editorial role (also co-editor of No Way Out). Noronha spoke at the 2018 Bengaluru memorial gathering ('UG used to tell him to forget UG completely').

title: Mind is a Myth, ed. Terry Newland - editions (Crest Associates 1987? / Dinesh Goa 1988; Smriti 2003 with Sunita Pant Bansal; Sentient 2007 ISBN 9781591810650)
description: Terry Newland's only known UG text is his editing/introduction of Mind is a Myth; PhilPapers indexes three records (KRIMIA, KRIMIA-2, KRIDCW). Sentient 2007, 165 pp.; Smriti 2003 'Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti'. Goodreads notes a 1987 Crest Associates (Gujarat) first edition - unverified vs Dinesh 1988.

title: Robert Carr - UG friend; posts tagged 'Robert Carr' on sulochanosho.wordpress.com
description: Only trace of Robert Carr's UG writings found; no book 'Love Children' confirmed by search.

title: ugkrishnamurti.in: Books about UG / translations page
description: Official-site list of books about UG and translations (Italian Aequilibrium 1990, Spanish Sirio '1989', German online 'Das Ende der Sehnsucht' 2002, Cezary Wójcik's Polish online translations).

title: Internet Archive PDFs: A Life (Bhatt), The Mystique of Enlightenment, On U.G. (185p), Stopped in Our Tracks (227p)
description: Public-domain-marked PDFs: A Life; The Mystique of Enlightenment; 'On U.G.' (185 pp.); Stopped in Our Tracks (227 pp.). Series 2 and 3 of Stopped in Our Tracks are on scribd.

title: holybooks.com: Mind is a Myth PDF; remembering-ug 'eBook - A Life (pdf)' post (Jan 2012)
description: holybooks hosts Mind is a Myth PDF (and The Natural State); remembering-ug blog E-Books posts include A Life (Jan 2012) and Thought is Your Enemy.

title: The Biology of Enlightenment - ISBNs 9789350290095 / 9789350292495 (HarperCollins India)
description: ISBN data for the 1967-71 transcripts volume.

title: दिमाग ही दुश्मन है (Dimag Hi Dushman Hai) - Hindi edition of Thought is Your Enemy
description: Hindi title listed on epustakalay and 44books; publisher/year not shown. No Hindi 'Mind is a Myth' or any Marathi book found (only a Marathi blog translation of the Mishlove interview on catalign.in).

title: true-dhamma.com Chinese UG section '实相与解构 / U.G.克里希那穆提'
description: Chinese renderings: 独自站立的勇气 (Courage to Stand Alone), 没有"真理"这回事 and 没有"心"这回事 (conversations, likely Mind is a Myth/Mystique), 一切开始的终结 (interviews with friends/TV/radio), 戳破一切迷思 (selections), 行将就木 (Brawley's Goner), plus English No Way Out PDF at file.true-dhamma.com. Pages dated 2025.

title: A Mística da Iluminação (Portuguese, 274 pp., ebook aggregator)
description: Only Portuguese UG title surfaced; publisher unknown, aggregator source.

title: WELL: Mystique of Enlightenment HTML parts (mystiq1.htm ... mystiq4.htm), Mind is a Myth intro.html & cover.html, Final_Remembering.htm
description: Confirmed filenames: mystiq1.htm ('MYSTIQUE OF ENLIGHTENMENT: Pt.1: U.G.'), mystiq4.htm (Part 4), intro.html ('Mind is a Myth / Introduction'), cover.html (Mind is a Myth cover), Final_Remembering.htm (notes first book put together by Rodney Arms, 1982). links.htm, thought.htm, natural_state.htm and photo pages not surfaced by search.

title: fr.wikisource: 'Le mental est un mythe (U. G. Krishnamurti) (bilingue)' translation project
description: User-space French-English bilingual Mind is a Myth on French Wikisource (in progress).

title: inner-quest.org UG pages (English UG_R, French UG_Fr, UG_H) and eti.martin.free.fr extract of 'Rencontres avec un éveillé contestataire'
description: French-language excerpts of UG conversations and an online extract of the French testimony book.

title: Il coraggio di essere liberi dal passato. Testo inglese a fronte (Jubal, Nov 2004)
description: Italian bilingual transcription of a conversation (Courage material), Jubal Editore, 103 pp.

title: Italian Mystique editions: L'inganno dell'illuminazione (Re Nudo, 2011); La mistica dell'illuminazione (Youcanprint, 2020); Il fascino dell'illuminazione (OM Edizioni, 2020)
description: Three Italian renderings of The Mystique of Enlightenment: Re Nudo Edizioni Feb 2011 (107 pp.); Youcanprint 2020 (254 pp.); OM Edizioni 2020 ISBN 978-88-32299-48-9.

title: Liberarsi delle illusioni (Alaya Edizioni 2004; Gruppo Editoriale Macro 2009) and Lo stato naturale. Scopri l'essenziale con U.G. (Aequilibrium, ISBN 9788898365128)
description: Further Italian UG titles; 'Il pensiero è il tuo nemico' appears only as a related-title link on Aequilibrium pages (publisher/date unconfirmed).

title: U.G.: Charlas con un iluminado contestatario (Editorial Sirio, 2013) - Spanish Mystique of Enlightenment
description: Spanish Mystique, Sirio, ISBN 978-84-7808-865-2.

title: El coraje de estar solo (Gulaab, ISBN 9788486797652)
description: Spanish Courage to Stand Alone listed in Casa del Libro catalogue under publisher Gulaab; year not shown.

title: Der Mut, allein zu stehen (Noumenon-Verlag, 2013, ISBN 9783941973183) and Mythos Mind - Märchenhafter Verstand (Noumenon, 2010, trans. Daniel Herbst, ISBN 3941973010)
description: Noumenon-Verlag German UG series: Courage (2013, hardcover) and Mind is a Myth (2010).

title: No Way Out (e-artnow, 2021, ISBN 9788027341498) - digital reissue
description: English ebook reissue by e-artnow; cf. 'Collected Works' e-bookshelf sample.

title: Wikipedia note: UG's 1961 letter to the Swami at the London Ramakrishna Mission
description: Before leaving the Ramakrishna Mission (where he worked three months in 1961) UG left a letter for the resident Swamiji; whereabouts unknown. Only item in UG's own hand referenced by search for the 1960s London/New York years.

title: spiritualteachers.org: 'U.G. Krishnamurti: The negating guru'
description: Profile with reader comments citing The Hindu's March 2007 death report; notes survivors (two daughters, a son).
